name: Laccha Paratha
subtitle: flaky layered paratha, pleated and coiled so it pulls apart in threads

ingredients.note: the layers are ghee; oil gives fewer and softer ones

prepNotes: The pleating is the whole dish. Roll thin, brush with ghee, dust with flour, pleat like a fan, then coil.
Rest the dough properly. Under-rested dough springs back and will not roll thin enough to layer.

steps.text: Make a soft dough with the flour, salt and warm water. Knead 8 minutes, oil the surface and rest 30 minutes.
Roll a ball out as thin as you can manage, almost translucent.
Brush generously with melted ghee and dust with maida.
steps.tip: The flour dusting keeps the layers from fusing back together.

steps.text: Pleat the sheet like a paper fan, stretch it gently, then coil it into a spiral and tuck the end under. Rest 10 minutes.
Roll the coil out gently to 18cm, keeping the spiral intact.
steps.tip: Gently. Press hard and you crush the layers you just built.

steps.text: Cook on a hot tawa with ghee, 2 minutes a side, then crush lightly between your palms to open the layers.

storage: Best straight off the tawa. They keep a day wrapped in a cloth at room temperature; reheat on a dry tawa, not a microwave.
